title: Better Improved Recipes
description: Adds balanced, better recipes for Minecraft!
body:
# About
Feeling Bored of Minecraft Recipes? Here is the Solution! Better Improved Recipes; adds many useful crafting recipes and tweaks!

These tweaks include, making crafting stairs get you more stairs, crafting trapdoors gives you more trapdoors, and being able to unpack stuff like Nether Wart Blocks into Nether Wart!



If you want me to add and update more amazing Recipes, contact me on discord! 
username below.
_____________________________________________________________________________________________

This Project is still in Beta! Please report any bugs, and the project is on the works!



## New Recipes:

Slabs -> Blocks

More Wood (4 Oak Logs -> 3 Oak Wood) -> (4 Oak Logs -> 4 Oak Wood)

Blast Furnace change: From 3 smooth stone to 3 normal stone.

Grindstone Change: From Stone Slab to Cobblestone Slab.

Blast Furnace Blasting Change: Blast Furnaces can now smelt glass, nether bricks, and blocks of ores!
